tasks.name: demo_buggy_task_board_dual_fix_combined_filters_and_archived_order
tasks.task: 修复 task_board CLI 的 list 过滤与展示顺序问题。核心逻辑集中在较大的文件 `task_board/query_engine.py` 中。现在运行 `python task_board.py list --owner alice --status todo` 时，结果会错误返回 owner 或 status 任一命中的任务；另外当显式传入 `--include-archived` 时，archived 任务会被错误排到 active 任务前面。请让默认 list 排除 archived 任务；当同时提供 `--owner` 和 `--status` 时，结果必须同时满足两个条件；当显式传入 `--include-archived` 时，再把 archived 任务包含进来，但 active 结果必须仍然排在 archived 结果前面，并保留各分组内现有排序规则和输出格式。

verify_rules.name: default combined filter returns only active alice todo task
verify_rules.regex: ^1\. \[todo\] Draft status page copy \| owner=alice \| priority=1$

verify_rules.name: include archived output keeps active task
verify_rules.contains: 1. [todo] Draft status page copy | owner=alice | priority=1

verify_rules.name: include archived output includes low priority archived task
include archived output includes original archived task
include archived output still excludes alice done task
active tasks stay before archived tasks
verify_rules.regex: (?s)^1\. \[todo\] Draft status page copy \| owner=alice \| priority=1\r?\n6\. \[todo\] Recover legacy screenshots \| owner=alice \| priority=0 \(archived\)\r?\n4\. \[todo\] Archive migration notes \| owner=alice \| priority=4 \(archived\)$
